title.narrative: Improving the Livelihoods of Sweet Potato Farmers through Crop Post-Harvest-Based Innovation System

description.narrative: This Action works towards bettering the infrastructure of an economically viable and self-sustaining sweet potato value chain in Sierra Leone that promotes sustainable growth, and creating jobs in the process. The Orange-Fleshed Sweet Potato (OFSP) is selected because of its financial and nutritional potential for farmers and communities.
